aspect: The profile is age, sex and nationality
description: A young Nigerian woman travelling alone matches a risk profile regardless of her purpose, funding or documents.
energy_note: Matching a profile you are not part of.

aspect: It produces refusals as well as delays
description: A visa officer who suspects trafficking may refuse rather than investigate, because refusal is the lower-risk decision for the officer - and it is recorded as an ordinary refusal.
energy_note: Refused for her own protection, on a form that does not say so.

aspect: And the good-faith version is still degrading
description: Being separated from a queue, questioned about who paid, and asked whether she is being made to travel - by people acting properly - is nevertheless an hour of being treated as possibly owned.
energy_note: Correctly screened, and humiliated by it.

description: She is twenty-three, travelling alone to a conference in Nairobi with an invitation letter and her own money. The officer asks who is sponsoring her, why she is going alone, and whether her father knows. He is doing his job and she is answering correctly and it takes thirty-five minutes.
energy_note: Screened properly, and humiliated by it.
